+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboLab limited-mode episode controller and observation recorder."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+OBS = OUT / "observations"
+OBS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+print(json.dumps({"connected": True, "protocol": spec.get("protocol"), "budget": spec.get("budget"),
+                  "action_types": spec.get("action_types"), "proprio_layout": spec.get("proprio_layout"),
+                  "proprio_groups": spec.get("proprio_groups"), "world": spec.get("world"),
+                  "robot_spec": spec.get("robot_spec"), "cameras": spec.get("cameras")}, default=str), flush=True)
+
+seq = 0
+
+def save_result(res, label):
+    global seq
+    seq += 1
+    d = OBS / f"{seq:03d}_{label}"
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=str))
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(im)).save(d / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=95)
+    for cam, dep in res.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f"{cam}_depth.npy", dep)
+    if res.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(d / "proprio.npy", res.proprio)
+    if res.frames:
+        for cam, frames in res.frames.items():
+            np.save(d / f"{cam}_frames.npy", frames)
+    if res.depth:
+        for cam, maps in res.depth.items():
+            np.savez_compressed(d / f"{cam}_depth_frames.npz", depth=maps)
+    if res.extrinsic_cv:
+        np.savez(d / "extrinsic_cv.npz", **res.extrinsic_cv)
+    summary = {"saved": str(d), "done": res.meta.get("done"), "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+               "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"), "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),
+               "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"), "control_steps_chunk": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+               "last_proprio": res.meta.get("proprio")}
+    print(json.dumps(summary, default=str), flush=True)
+
+def dispatch(cmd):
+    op = cmd["op"]
+    if op == "obs":
+        res = r.get_obs(depth=cmd.get("depth", True), video="frames")
+        save_result(res, "obs")
+    elif op == "wait":
+        res = r.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 1)), depth=cmd.get("depth", True), video="frames")
+        save_result(res, "wait")
+    elif op in ("pose", "joints"):
+        kind = "ee_pose" if op == "pose" else "joint_position"
+        res = r.submit(kind, cmd["actions"], dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 0.2)),
+                       video=cmd.get("video", "none"), depth=cmd.get("depth", "last"))
+        save_result(res, op)
+    elif op == "status":
+        print(json.dumps(r.status(), default=str), flush=True)
+    elif op == "ik":
+        ans = r.ik({cmd.get("frame", "tcp"): cmd["pose"]}, seed=cmd.get("seed"))
+        print(json.dumps(ans, default=str), flush=True)
+    elif op == "fk":
+        ans = r.fk(cmd["q"], links=cmd.get("links"))
+        print(json.dumps(ans, default=str), flush=True)
+    elif op == "quit":
+        raise EOFError
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown op: {op}")
+
+while True:
+    line = sys.stdin.readline()
+    if not line:
+        break
+    try:
+        dispatch(json.loads(line))
+    except EOFError:
+        break
+    except EpisodeOver as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"episode_over": str(e)}), flush=True)
+        break
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": repr(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
